summary: Complete string inventory of the client-side hooks (P1 action gate + reply lint + banner echo + iron-rule check + session start). Channel legend: "systemMessage" = JSON systemMessage field on hook stdout, rendered to the human in the Claude Code UI; "hookSpecificOutput.reason" = the PreToolUse block-decision reason, fed to the model; "hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext" = context injected to the model (user only sees it if the AI echoes it — the "Response format" lines exist to force that echo); "stderr" = Stop-hook exit-2 stderr, the model's rewrite instruction (code comments claim it also renders as the block reason); "stdout-cli" = terminal output of a manually run CLI; "log-file" = local JSONL audit records, developer-only. Files with ZERO emitted strings: hooks/lib/gate-provision.js (writes only state files: sessionId into gate-current-session, hex nonces) and hooks/lib/notice-throttle.js (state JSON only). Localization traps: (1) the "NOT gated" and "degraded" lines exist in THREE literal copies (action-gate-cli.js, ownmind-iron-rule-check.js, ownmind-iron-rule-check.sh) that must stay in sync; (2) the version-tag block and the verification reminder each exist as an English twin (.js) and a Chinese twin (.sh) of the same message; (3) userLine strings from action-gate.js pass through both PreToolUse wirings verbatim as systemMessage; (4) some strings embed literal Chinese tokens by design (好 / 誤判 / 確認 / 白話 formats) that are protocol words, not incidental language. Out-of-scope pass-throughs noted but not inventoried (strings originate in modules not on the reading list): renderHookContextLine (shared/hook-context.js), editReminder (hooks/ownmind-edit-reminder.js), renderSessionContext (hooks/lib/render-session-context.js), queueUpdateBanner (shared/update-banner.js), ownmind-render-context.js output in the .sh hook, and lint violation messages v.message produced by shared/language-lint.js validators.
